sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-11,200 (levels 1-18). 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Hunter's Aura, vitality 4.8k at Lifestrike.

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Frenzy later.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Hunter's Aura completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Hunter's Aura completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Hunter's Aura completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Stalker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 11,200-24,800 (levels 18-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Boot Kick T3, Lycan Curse T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Boot Kick, bonus damage) grows from 69.9 to 202.

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 8,800 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Express Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,800 to 12,000 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Lycan Curse: its duration-scaled parts (duration 15s, stack duration 5s) get +22%.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Superior Duration, 11200 souls (~11.2 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Berserker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,800-44,000 (levels 28-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Slam Fire T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Boot Kick, bonus damage) grows from 202 to 254. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Superior Duration.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Boot Kick (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown. Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Lycan Curse duration (15s), Lycan Curse stack duration (5s), Slam Fire duration (5s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Frenzy
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 15,200 to 20,800 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows keep you off them.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is out-shooting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Lycan Curse gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (60s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Lycan Curse counts as your ult, so every wolf form gives you the barrier. Sell Spirit Shielding for this.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

sections.label: Losing lane (temporary)
sections.legacy_desc: Get Lifestrike right after Stalker, then carry on.
